summary: Add a redacted read-only Naver login status MCP tool and narrow read scopes for cart inspection.

tasks.title: Add the fixed Naver login status read flow
tasks.target: MCP tool dispatch, scoped Naver navigation policy, and status classifier
tasks.change: Register naver.login_status with browser:read only, route it through IPC and runtime, temporarily allow only https://www.naver.com/ and fixed static origins for GET/HEAD, classify top-bar markers into a two-field enum result, and document the contract.
tasks.effect: Fixture HTML produces logged_in, logged_out, or unknown without emitting DOM text, names, emails, query-bearing URLs, or cookies; unrelated origins and WebSockets remain denied.

verification.risk_reason: The feature changes browser navigation allowlists, authorization scopes, and data returned from a page; a guard regression could expose data or permit an unintended request.
verification.test_reason: Add fixture-based redaction and classification coverage, plus regression checks for scope enforcement and operation routing; run the exact requested unit suite.
verification.subject: Naver login status classification, output redaction, narrow navigation policy, and read/write scope boundaries
verification.procedure: Run npx vitest run test/unit/agent-mcp.test.mjs test/unit/agent-runtime.test.mjs test/unit/agent-worker.test.mjs test/unit/agent-ipc.test.mjs test/unit/agent-naver-cart.test.mjs test/unit/agent-cart-flow.test.mjs test/unit/agent-naver-login-status.test.mjs.
verification.pass_criterion: All requested and new unit tests pass; tool output contains only status/evidence enum fields; the homepage and fixed static hosts allow GET/HEAD only during this operation; cart reads require browser:read and prepare/set require cart:write.
